4.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:

AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREAS

4.2- OTHER AIRCRAFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE ABOVE DESCRIBED AREAS WILL BE AUTHORIZED TO ENTER THESE AREAS AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION
